name: canvas
title: Infinite Canvas
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: Pannable, zoomable whiteboard surface with rubber-band multi-select and drag. Pan and drag write directly to the DOM for zero-re-render performance — React only renders what's inside each node.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/canvas. Wrap your surface with CanvasRoot, render CanvasViewport inside it, and pass nodes rendered through CanvasNodeView. Use useCanvas for programmatic pan/zoom/selection control from any child component.
